note: What a temple or its surroundings can need, in temple terms. Used by the server (validation), the needs board and the report form. Keys are stable; add new ones, never rename. 'legacy' maps older keys to current ones.

categories.label: Temple tank (pushkarini / kulam) and water body
categories.hint: Algae, floating waste, sewage inflow or bad smell. Say if devotees bathe or perform rituals in it.

categories.label: Flower, puja and prasadam waste
categories.hint: Garlands, leaves, coconut shells, oil, banana leaves and prasadam packaging that are not collected.

categories.label: Litter in the prakaram and halls
categories.hint: Rubbish in the circumambulation path, corridors, mandapams or the entrance.

categories.label: Toilets and washing areas for devotees
categories.hint: Missing, locked, dirty or without water; foot-washing and drainage areas.

categories.label: Drinking water for devotees
categories.hint: No safe drinking water, broken taps or dirty containers.

categories.label: Gopuram, sculpture and mandapam repair
categories.hint: Cracks, leaks, broken stone, peeling paint on sculptures, damaged pillars or roofs.

categories.label: Footwear stand, shade and queue shelter
categories.hint: Unsafe footwear arrangements, hot floors, no cover from sun or rain in the queue.

categories.label: Access for elders and wheelchairs
categories.hint: No ramp, steep steps, slippery floors, no seating for the elderly.

categories.label: Lighting, safety and crowd control
categories.hint: Dark corridors, exposed wiring, blocked exits, unmanaged queues on festival days.

categories.label: Approach road, parking and surroundings
categories.hint: Garbage near the temple, encroachment, parking chaos, damaged road or ghat steps.

categories.label: Smoke, soot and noise
categories.hint: Heavy lamp or camphor soot, burning waste, loudspeakers or crackers.

categories.label: Other
categories.hint: Anything else the temple or devotees need.
